items.t: الحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الذِي عَافَانِي مِمَّا اِبْتَلَاكَ بِهِ وَفَضَّلَنِي عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِمَّنْ خَلَقَ تَفْضِيلًا
items.en: All praise is for Allah Who saved me from that which He tested you with and Who most certainly favoured me over much of His creation.
items.tl: Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi alladhī ʿāfānī mimmā ibtalāka bihi, wa faḍḍalanī ʿalā ka-thīrin mimman khalaqa tafḍīlā
